unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: P1 L1 still admits a natural alternative order after the per hari repair
evidence: The new canonical chips are [sedangkan] [yang dekat kantor] [menghemat waktu saya] [hampir dua jam] [per hari.].
Zero-based order [0,1,4,2,3], disregarding punctuation as required, gives: Yang di pinggir kota jelas lebih hemat, sedangkan yang dekat kantor per hari menghemat waktu saya hampir dua jam.
Per hari can precede the predicate as a rate/frequency adjunct and preserves the same commute-saving claim. Its period cannot be the sole reason to reject that otherwise natural order.
The structural native gate correctly checks only canonical reconstruction; it does not claim to prove permutation uniqueness. No alternate-order field or runtime acceptance was demonstrated.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.arbitration: Fable classified the prior finding FIX because per hari binds duration. This independent rereview does not consider that sufficient proof of unique order. The P2 L2 first-clause swap and P2 L6 time-fronting examples from the initial finding are eliminated by the new fixed prefixes; no claim of exhaustive permutation proof is made for those or the other builds.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredFix: Before publication, support and test the natural authored order above, or obtain a native-reviewed regrouping/visible target cue that makes the exercise uniquely answerable. Do not alter canonical audio merely to silence the structural gate.

unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Jika begitu remains an explicit unresolved acceptance disagreement
evidence: The exact displayed frames are ___, kita tetapkan hari Selasa dan Kamis sebagai hari semua orang di kantor untuk rapat. and ___, gabungkan: aplikasi untuk kosakata tiap hari, dan kelas percakapan dua minggu sekali di akhir pekan.
Both authored lists accept only Kalau begitu. The initial review identified Jika begitu as a grammatical alternative in these contexts.

Fable explicitly marked this finding PARTIAL and rejected Jika begitu as not natural spoken Indonesian for the fixed frame. The final artifacts preserve that decision; the review does not conceal the disagreement or fabricate extra accepted answers.
Ten other requested variant additions were applied exactly and personally reread in their complete frames. Acceptance is bounded; neither the gate nor this report claims exhaustive synonym coverage.

Canonical lines natural spoken standard Indonesian, registers hold (no kamu/aku in formal, no Anda in neutral, no banned particles, zero Pak/Bu), them2 genuine challenge and them4 genuine steer in every lesson, moves distinct, staging honoured (kalaupun/terjangkau only L8-9, justru itu/gabungkan/berarti L4-7), trophies match ledger with correct anchors, no digits, reduplications intact, RT absent.
